title: Living Legacy: Sandkeep Endurance Raid
summary: Hold off Sandkeep's replenishing army for 70 minutes. Each full minute earns one reward model, reaching Model LXX at victory. There is no minimum DPS requirement.
overview: This is a survival encounter, not a boss-kill race. Establish control of Eothar and six opening guards, then handle gradual reinforcements. The old raid-wide control spells have been removed.

Rewards advance once per full minute survived. A shorter attempt keeps its completed models; surviving all 70 minutes earns Model LXX and ends the battle with a raid and server-wide victory announcement.
Everyone alive and present when the encounter begins keeps credit for the raid's progress, even after dying or leaving the zone. Arriving later does not add a player to the starting roster.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Be inside the instance and ready before choosing Begin. The expedition locks as combat starts, so you cannot leave for mana recovery and re-enter during the attempt.
Keep at least half the living enemies engaged. There is no damage quota, but leaving most of the army unattended eventually ends the attempt.
Keep more than half the starting raid alive and in the zone. Deaths and departures count toward the same failure condition.
When Eothar gathers power, move more than 25 paces away within five seconds. Return after the surge.

roles.label: Tanks
tips: Assign a tank to Eothar. He cannot be killed, so control him rather than spending raid damage on him.
Spread add assignments across the field and pick up replacements quickly. Defeated adds return after 12 seconds.

roles.label: Healers
tips: Plan healing and mana use for a long fight. Melee pressure increases each minute.
Coordinate tank healing and conserve resources. The old spell stuns, feign death, knockback, curses, poison ticks and mana/endurance drains are no longer encounter mechanics.

roles.label: Damage and add control
tips: Kill the efreeti, golems, and dervishes to reduce immediate pressure, then prepare for their replacements.
Coordinate with tanks so living enemies stay engaged. Dead enemies waiting to respawn do not count against the raid.
Mez, stun, root, snare and slow can help manage the guards. Their resists are low and slows are not weakened; native spell level limits still apply.

phases.label: Prepare the raid
phases.description: Enter through Dougan's Ready option, gather near Rayna or the battlefield, and assign tanks and healers. The survival clock starts only when Begin is chosen.

phases.label: Establish the line
phases.description: Eothar and six guards awaken: one efreeti, two golems and three dervishes. Establish tank assignments. No special attack occurs before the first minute; afterward Eothar warns before his surge.

phases.label: Gradual reinforcements
phases.description: Two additional guards join every two minutes until all 26 add positions are active. Defeated guards still return after 12 seconds. Pick up new arrivals and keep enough living enemies engaged.

phases.label: Survive the full army
phases.description: The field is capped at Eothar and 26 adds. Health and damage continue rising gradually. Keep controlling the guards and step away for each warned surge.

phases.label: Sandkeep conquered
phases.description: Model LXX is earned, combat ends, and the victory is announced to the raid and server. The army withdraws after three seconds. Entry reopens for corpse recovery once the battlefield is cleared; another attempt requires a new expedition.

abilities.name: Sandkeep surge
abilities.summary: Eothar warns before a small, short-range damage burst. Move away from him.
description: The first warning comes after one full minute. You have five seconds to move more than 25 paces from Eothar; the burst checks distance and height at impact. Only living members of the starting roster inside that area are hit.

Impacts are at least 25 seconds apart. Damage scales with starting raid size, elapsed minutes and the shared damage setting. It does not stun, feign death, knock back, drain resources or leave a damage-over-time effect.
The guards no longer cast the old native encounter spells or use rampage, flurry or summon. Ordinary native melee and bash/kick behavior still apply.

sections.title: Getting started
paragraphs: Request Sandkeep Endurance from Dougan Merule in South Ro. Requesting creates the expedition without zoning the raid in; each assigned member chooses Ready to enter The Root of Ro.
bullets: Gather 6 to 54 living players near Rayna or the battlefield, then choose Begin when the raid is ready.
All living players already in the instance are captured at the start, up to 54. Wait for everyone before beginning.
Entry is blocked while the attempt is active, including for assigned members who die or zone out.

sections.title: The enemy field
paragraphs: Begin creates one unkillable Eothar, one efreeti, two golems and three dervishes. Two guards join every two minutes, reaching the full four efreeti, eight golems and fourteen dervishes at 20:00. Defeated guards return 12 seconds after death.
bullets: Distribute tanking and add control instead of concentrating the entire raid on Eothar.
Keep at least half the currently living enemies engaged with starting raid members or their pets. Other players do not satisfy this condition.
Dead adds waiting to respawn are excluded from the idle-enemy count.
Inactive reinforcement positions do not contain enemies and do not count toward idle failure.

sections.title: Failure and corpse recovery
paragraphs: There is no minimum DPS requirement, pressure window, or missed-DPS recovery phase. Failure is based on raid survival and leaving enemies unattended.
bullets: The attempt ends if more than half the starting raid is dead or absent for five continuous seconds. Recovering to at least half alive and present resets that countdown.
If more than half the living enemies remain unattended, the raid receives a warning at 90 seconds and fails at 120 seconds. Re-engaging enough enemies resets the warning and countdown.
After failure, the enemies disappear after three seconds. Once cleanup finishes and entry reopens, assigned members can return through Dougan to recover corpses.
Completed reward models are retained. Neither a failed nor a victorious instance can restart the encounter; request a new expedition for another attempt.

sections.title: How difficulty scales
paragraphs: The starting raid size scales enemy health and melee damage. Larger raids must coordinate more pressure and healing rather than expecting the same enemies as a smaller force.
bullets: Enemy AC rises with the captured roster, from 100 at six players to 400 at 54 players. It does not rise each minute.
Opening health is reduced, then eases into a much gentler health curve. Add regeneration and attack strength are lower. Enemies remain level 60.
Melee is another 30 percent lower than the previous half-strength tuning, before starting-roster, elapsed-minute and global scaling. Surge damage also grows with starting roster and elapsed time.
Adds use low elemental and magic resists, with no slow mitigation. This improves spell landing and control without bypassing native spell level caps or guaranteeing every spell lands.
Enemy special melee attacks and all five old native encounter spells are removed. The new movement mechanic is damage-only; it cannot apply their control effects or resource drains.

sections.title: Reward progress
paragraphs: Each full minute survived earns one model: Model I at 1:00, Model X at 10:00, and the maximum Model LXX at 70:00. Partial minutes and post-fight cleanup do not earn another model.
bullets: Progress is saved for the full starting roster, including members who later die, disconnect, or leave the zone. Those losses can still trigger encounter failure.
Your personal best never decreases. A shorter future attempt does not replace a higher result.
Recover your earned event abacus from the reward facilitator in the Plane of Knowledge. Move it into inventory and click it to claim your best recorded model.
Only one augment from each Living Legacy reward line may be owned. An existing augment from this line blocks another claim without consuming the abacus.

loot.title: Reward token
loot.description: Recovered after earning at least Model I. Clicking the token requests the augment at your best recorded model.

loot.title: Maximum reward
loot.description: Model LXX is earned by surviving the full 70-minute encounter. Shorter attempts retain their completed models instead.

items.name: Carefully Weighted Brass Pinion Model LXX [Bastion]

notes: Approval E340 retained. Reviewed the committed October 29 Endurance survival redesign. The revision identifies the quest commit; file hashes identify the reviewed source files.

Source-reviewed, not live-verified. The supplied October 27 player log documents the previous control-spell failures, not acceptance of this new design. A new live raid must verify tanking, healing, spell landing, movement readability and later progression.

The surge is scripted direct damage and has no spell ID. Canonical legacy spell records, reward items, models, locations and templates are unchanged. No new SQL is required for an existing installation.
